description: Agent Migration: submit the migration report written for the principal, with the record behind it: its title, its audience, its headline as written and optionally its text; whether it states what the move lost, the fields dropped in the mapping, the fields whose meaning changed (units, currencies or status values) and the areas not verified against the source, where each sits (beside the headline, in a later section, in an appendix or in a separate document) and how many it names; and optionally the record of each, as found by the scope, export, mapping, loss and verification records. The signed report gives the headline with any complete or lossless wording, the disclosure of each kind of finding and the record, and names a move smoothed into migration complete: losses, dropped fields, meaning changes or unverified areas left out or stated as none while the record holds some; then counts below the record’s, disclosures in an appendix or a separate document, and wording such as migration complete, seamless or nothing lost while the record holds findings, with the fix for each. The export section of a handover package is wever_handover-check, and whether a reputation record survives a platform change in principle is wever_reputation-portability-check. Verdict migration_smoothed_over, migration_disclosure_gaps, migration_disclosure_unverified or migration_disclosed. POST /api/migration-report-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write, and no data is moved. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-migration-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-migration/.
